summary: YXT.COM Group Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing a registered direct offering of 500,000 American Depositary Shares (ADSs), each representing 30 Class A ordinary shares, at $3.00 per ADS, raising gross proceeds of $1.5 million. The purchaser is a non-affiliated institutional investor, with Univest Securities acting as placement agent on a reasonable best efforts basis. The company intends to use net proceeds for R&D, technology infrastructure, marketing, strategic investments, and general corporate purposes. The offering is a routine capital raise under an existing Form F-3 shelf registration statement, not a special situation.
